newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to 25.566 bln stg in week to July 16.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to 25.566 bln stg in week to July 16.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.566 billion stg in the week to July 16 from 25.486 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.654 billion stg from 25.592 billion.

Notes and coins in circulation were slightly higher at 25.334 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.328 billion the previous week but dropped to 25.422 billion from 25.434 billion stg on an unadjusted basis.
